description: This file implements an in-memory rate limiting middleware for a web application using the Starlette framework. It defines the RateLimitMiddleware class, which applies sliding window rate limiting based on request keys, and manages rate limit counters with timestamps stored in deques.

classes.name: RateLimitMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for applying sliding window rate limiting based on request keys.

methods.name: __init__( self, app, requests: int, window_seconds: int, key_func: Callable[[dict], str], )
methods.description: Initializes the rate limit middleware with application, request limit, window size, and key function.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next)
methods.description: Handles each incoming request, enforces rate limiting, updates counters, and adds rate limit headers to responses.
